content.text: {"subject":"Math","mode":"questions","extracted_questions":[{"question":"24 + 13 =","answer":"37","reasoning":"Add ones first (4+3=7), then tens (20+10=30), total 37 - check her written answer matches.","photo":0,"box":[182,355,650,400]},{"question":"45 − 18 =","answer":"27","reasoning":"Ask Ishika to borrow from tens place: 45-18, 15-8=7, 30-10=20, so 27; her sheet shows 33 which is wrong, let her redo it.","photo":0,"box":[182,485,650,535]},{"question":"56 + 27 =","answer":"83","reasoning":"Add ones: 6+7=13, write 3 carry 1; tens: 5+2+1=8, giving 83; sheet shows 73, ask her to recheck the carry.","photo":0,"box":[182,615,650,665]},{"question":"90 − 42 =","answer":"48","reasoning":"Ask her to subtract tens and ones carefully: 90-42, borrow to get 10-2=8, 8-4=4, giving 48 - her written 48 is correct.","photo":0,"box":[182,745,650,795]}],"concept_explanation":null,"aditiApplicable":false,"aditiHook":null}
